note: **Turns every raw ticket into a prompt plus the answer we want back.**
- `map()` runs the helper on every row of both splits
- Lab 3 uses this split to grade only the answer

extra/lab1_prep_complete.txt.title: Render the chat template
note: **Wraps the same ticket in the model's own chat markers.**
- Every model family has its own markers, stored in its tokenizer
- `add_generation_prompt=True` tells the model it's its turn to answer

extra/lab1_prep_complete.txt.anchor: preds = generate_predictions(model, tokenizer, eval_rows, max_new_tokens=24, show=3)
extra/lab1_prep_complete.txt.title: Baseline predictions
note: **Asks the untrained model to triage 20 held-out tickets.**
- `show=3` prints three examples so you can see what it produced

extra/lab1_prep_complete.txt.title: Score the baseline
note: **Grades the predictions on four separate checks: format, category, priority, queue.**
- This is the number every later lab must beat

extra/lab2_fullft_complete.txt.title: One training string per ticket
note: **Joins prompt, correct answer, and an end token into one string to train on.**
- The end token is how the model learns where to stop

extra/lab2_fullft_complete.txt.title: Data collator
note: **Pads each batch to equal length and builds the labels the model is graded on.**
- Padding positions get -100, meaning 'don't grade this'
- `mlm=False`: predict the next word, not fill in blanks

extra/lab2_fullft_complete.txt.title: Training settings
note: **How long, how fast, and on what hardware to train.**
- 2 passes over the data, 8 examples per step
- `warmup_steps=0.05` means 5% of training, not 0.05 steps
- `use_cpu=True` replaces the removed `no_cuda`

extra/lab2_fullft_complete.txt.title: Hand the data to the Trainer
note: **Gives the Trainer the tokenized tickets, the collator, and the tokenizer.**
- `processing_class=` is the new name for `tokenizer=`

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.anchor: r=16,                    # adapter size: bigger can learn more
extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.endAnchor: use_dora=False,          # the optional step at the end of the lab turns this on
extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: LoRA settings
note: **How big the adapters are, and which layers they attach to.**
- `r`: adapter size. `lora_alpha`: how strongly it counts (2 x r)
- `target_modules`: the seven layer names from Step 2
- `use_dora`: turned on in the optional step at the end

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: Attach the adapters
note: **Freezes the model and adds small trainable adapters next to its layers.**
- The printed line shows only about 2% of the model will train

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: Grade only the answer
note: **Marks the prompt part -100 ("don't grade"), so only the answer is graded.**
- Lab 2 also graded the model on retyping the ticket

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: Hand the data to the Trainer
note: **Same Trainer as Lab 2, but now it trains only the adapters.**
- Padding is marked -100 too, so filler is never graded

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: 4-bit quantization settings
note: **Store the frozen model in 4 bits instead of 32 to save memory.**
- `nf4`: 4-bit format tuned to how trained weights are spread
- Math still runs at 16-bit; double quant shrinks the overhead too

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: Load the model in 4-bit
note: **Passes those settings in while loading, so weights are stored in 4 bits.**
- The old `load_in_4bit=True` shortcut no longer exists

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: Prepare a 4-bit model for training
note: **Small housekeeping that lets training run safely on top of 4-bit weights.**

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: Same LoRA settings as Lab 3
note: **Identical adapter settings to Lab 3 — only the base model's storage changed.**
- That's what makes Lab 3 vs. Lab 4 a fair comparison

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: Merge the adapter
note: **Loads the trained adapter and folds it permanently into the base model.**
- Merged into a 16-bit base, never the 4-bit one
- The result is an ordinary model with no adapter files

extra/lab5_eval_complete.txt.title: Attach the Lab 3 adapter
note: **Loads the base model and puts your Lab 3 adapter back on top.**
- This is how an adapter is used outside the training script

extra/lab5_eval_complete.txt.title: Tally right and wrong per category
note: **Counts correct answers per category and records each mix-up.**
- The mix-ups print as 'true -> predicted' pairs in STEP 3

extra/lab5_eval_complete.txt.title: Optional frontier comparison
note: **Sends the same 20 tickets to a large hosted model on Groq.**
- Returns nothing and skips cleanly if no Groq key is set
